title: BACKROOM!!!
description: A comprehensive Backrooms modpack featuring multiple faithful mods and multiplayer support.
body: This Minecraft modpack is completely focused on the Backrooms. It brings the eerie, endless creepypasta levels to life by combining multiple faithful Backrooms mods into one cohesive experience. Explore terrifying custom dimensions, face dangerous entities, and try to survive the endless hallways either alone or with your friends in multiplayer mode.
